Bagseed character style correction. The Soil Shed representative: light warm skin, brown wavy hair and solid full brown beard, olive green baseball cap, red/brown plaid button shirt, navy jeans, tan cream-soled sneakers. Doug-like soft rounded belly. REDRAW this character completely in the approved soft illustrated style, retaining identity and exact outfit/colors. Reference1 supplies identity ONLY; reference2 is the approved style authority: BIG ROUND head about ONE THIRD full figure height and nearly shoulder-width; LARGE dark eyes EACH with a clear WHITE highlight dot; soft friendly cheeks, little mouth, short soft limbs and mitten hands. Doug-like soft round belly for heavy builds and NARROW rounded shoulders. No square torsos, muscles, long limbs, realistic small heads, tiny dot eyes, textured stubble or noise. Warm dark-BROWN outlines and 2-3 broad CEL SHADING tones, solid simplified hair/beard shapes.
Produce ONE SQUARE transparent 3-column x 3-row atlas, nine NONOVERLAPPING evenly sized cells, generous empty transparent gutters. Row1: full-body IDLE FRONT, full-body RIGHT PROFILE, full-body BACK. Row2: shoulder-up PORTRAIT NEUTRAL, PORTRAIT FRIENDLY smiling, PORTRAIT CONCERNED; heads fill about 60% of portrait height. Row3: full-body HOLDING NOSE FRONT, HOLDING NOSE RIGHT PROFILE, HOLDING NOSE BACK, pinching nose with one hand, other arm lowered, exact same standing body size as Row1. All full-body drawings show complete shoes, consistent ground line within each cell, no walking stride. No text, labels, borders, ground shadows, glow or background. Clear readable game sprite illustrations, head/body ratio is the priority.
